činana: činana — on the far side, beyond (the Ming 那邊 'that side') (adverb) [那邊]

bulγa: bulγa — revolt, rebellion (noun; Ming 反) [反] · also 'turmoil, fighting' (Ming 厮殺 'slaughter')

baγ̇užu: baγu- — to come down, descend; converb -žu, 'descending' (verb, converb) [下來着] · baγ̇u- also 'to dismount, to camp' (Ming 下), converb -žu 'dismounting, camping' [下着]
